messages.content:
Given a question and an answer, analyze the complexity of each sentence in the answer. Break down each sentence into one or more fully understandable statements. Ensure that no pronouns are used in any statement. Format the outputs in JSON.
Please return the output in a JSON format that complies with the following schema as specified in JSON Schema:
{"properties": {"statements": {"description": "The generated statements", "items": {"type": "string"}, "title": "Statements", "type": "array"}}, "required": ["statements"], "title": "StatementGeneratorOutput", "type": "object"}Do not use single quotes in your response but double quotes,properly escaped with a backslash.

--------EXAMPLES-----------
Example 1
Input: {
    "question": "Who was Albert Einstein and what is he best known for?",
    "answer": "He was a German-born theoretical physicist, widely acknowledged to be one of the greatest and most influential physicists of all time. He was best known for developing the theory of relativity, he also made important contributions to the development of the theory of quantum mechanics."
}
Output: {
    "statements": [
        "Albert Einstein was a German-born theoretical physicist.",
        "Albert Einstein is recognized as one of the greatest and most influential physicists of all time.",
        "Albert Einstein was best known for developing the theory of relativity.",
        "Albert Einstein also made important contributions to the development of the theory of quantum mechanics."
    ]
}
-----------------------------

Now perform the same with the following input

    "question": "user: Why can't house prices be out of tune with salaries\nassistant: House prices cannot be out of tune with salaries in the long term. The equilibrium median home price tends to align with the price supported by the median income. A hypothetical scenario where if house prices rise 1% faster than salaries indefinitely, the average house will become extremely expensive compared to the average salary in the far future, which is not plausible.\nuser: That means ppl in the NYC earn a lot!!!\nassistant: The min wage in NYC was higher than the rest of NY state. However, cost of living differences are the big equalizer among states and area.\nuser: what is a current mortgage interest rate?\nassistant: I don't have specific information about the current mortgage interest rate.  It's best to check with a financial institution or mortgage lender for the most up-to-date information.\nuser: major cities with lowest living expense in the US\nassistant: Parts of the Midwest, the cost of living is low. Frisco also has much lower cost of living.\nAdditionally, Texas has a relatively lower time frame to pay off debts (5.68 years) compared to the national average (7.45 years), which could indicate a lower cost of living. \nuser: Is there federal help for the first time buyers?\nassistant: Yes, there are federal programs available to assist first-time homebuyers in the United States. One such program is the Federal Housing Administration (FHA) first-time buyer program, which requires a 3.5% down payment.
